verdict: CF earned $436M for its owners in Q3 as higher nitrogen prices lifted sales 12% to $1.86B — and a $62M insurance payout softened the hit from the Yazoo City outage.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Net sales were $1,860M, vs $1,659M a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $2.19 a year ago — attributable to common stockholders

segments.name: UAN
segments.note: Urea ammonium nitrate solution — a liquid fertilizer. The largest segment this quarter; volumes rose 27%.

segments.name: Ammonia
segments.note: Anhydrous ammonia — the base nitrogen product, sold as fertilizer and for industrial uses. Prices rose 27% per ton.

segments.name: Granular urea
segments.note: Solid urea fertilizer, upgraded from ammonia on-site.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Diesel exhaust fluid, urea liquor, nitric acid and similar products.

segments.name: AN
segments.note: Ammonium nitrate — fertilizer and explosives ingredient. Sales halved because the Yazoo City complex outage cut supply.

opex.name: SG&A & other operating items, net
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative costs of $87M, mostly offset by a $62M business-interruption insurance recovery for the Yazoo City outage and $2M of other operating income — a net $23M cost.

otherDetail: Interest and other items cost $78M net after counting the $4M equity line: $168M of interest expense, partly offset by $92M of interest income, plus $6M of other non-operating costs and $4M of earnings from an operating affiliate.
oneTimers: A $62M business-interruption insurance recovery (for the November 2025 incident and ongoing outage at the Yazoo City complex) is counted inside operating results — without it, operating costs net would have been about $85M and operating earnings about $639M on this page's basis.
Nine-month 2026 results (not this quarter) include a gain of about $170M from a litigation settlement and a $23M asset impairment.
footerNote: Adaptation: CF reports operating earnings of $701M including $4M of equity income from an affiliate; here that $4M rides on the flow's equity line, so operating income shows as $697M. Total net earnings were $520M; $436M was attributable to common stockholders after $84M went to noncontrolling interests — mainly the JERA and Mitsui stakes in the Blue Point One joint venture, which CF consolidates.

takeaways.title: Prices did the lifting
takeaways.text: Sales rose 12% to $1.86B. Ammonia prices rose 27% per ton and UAN volumes jumped 27%; excluding lost Yazoo City supply, volumes would have been up about 13% overall.

takeaways.title: Yazoo City is still a drag
takeaways.text: AN sales fell 45% to $67M and the segment's gross margin shrank to $3M because the Mississippi complex remains partly out after last November's incident. Insurance recoveries — $62M this quarter — are cushioning the loss.

takeaways.title: Cash keeps compounding
takeaways.text: Free cash flow over the last twelve months was $2.03B. CF spent $367M on buybacks in Q3 alone, and construction of the low-carbon Blue Point One ammonia plant began in August.
